title: Queued Space campaign and batched reply sends re-check the custom sender before they go out

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), Space email review of #3363 (EMAIL-011) and #3379.

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: the custom From is resolved once at enqueue (lib/spaces/email.ts campaign enqueue, and metadata.batch_from for batched replies). runSpaceCampaignEmail sends p.from as-is after checking only Space status, and the batch flush sends batch_from. Campaign jobs are spread out by bulkRunAfter, so a downgrade, pause or lost DNS verification mid-campaign still sends from the custom domain, contradicting email-identity-policy.ts ('call with fresh state immediately before custom delivery') and SPACE-EMAIL-BUILD-PLAN ('enforce at the provider dispatch boundary', 'queued custom sends move to a visible entitlement hold'). pauseSpaceEmailIdentity has no caller. THE FIX: carry identityId in the job payload and batch metadata; the worker and the flush call resolveSpaceEmailIdentity and fail the send visibly on refusal, never falling back to the Frequency address. Part of EMAIL-011's open work.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/resolveSpaceEmailIdentity/.test(r('lib/spaces/email.ts'))||!/resolveSpaceEmailIdentity/.test(r('lib/comms/outbound-batch.ts'))){console.error('SCAN-828: queued custom-sender sends never re-resolve the identity at dispatch');process.exit(1)}"
